title: They didn't fit our Eureka vacuum - something is off with the model numbers
text:
They didn't fit our Eureka vacuum - something is off with the model numbers. The belts are okay, but our experience wasn't so great.
While we ordered the belt for our model number, the belts we received (two in a package) did NOT
fit our vacuum. We were sent the right belt - our model number is right on the package.
But they did NOT fit at all, and were way too loose.

Eureka needs to review the models and belts, because something is off here.
We didn't return it because we already messed one of the two up just trying it out on our vacuum.
So, our nice Eureka remains dormant in need of a decent belt. Darned shame we can't rely on
the package to be accurate. I am not sure if this is another brand that claims to fit this Eureka, or
if they are actual Eureka belts (I no longer have the package in front of me), but it was a fail. :-(
